theme_central: Trial is inseparable from faith; relying on anything other than Allah is as fragile as a spider's web — the divine commentary on the destroyed tyrants (Pharaoh, Qarun) mentioned just before in Al-Qasas.
sources_note: Well-sourced structure (abrahamicstudyhall.org), explicitly linked with the previous surah (Al-Qasas): the parallel is confirmed by the source itself.

branches.title: Opening: trial inseparable from faith
branches.resume: No one says "I believe" without being tested; kindness to parents except in disobedience to Allah.

children.t: No one says "I believe" without being put to the test
Warning against wrongdoing, kindness to parents within limits

branches.title: Nuh and Ibrahim
branches.resume: Nuh's long patient struggle, Ibrahim's debate with his people, saved from the fire.

children.t: Nuh, 950 years of patient struggle with his people
Ibrahim debates with his people, miraculously saved from the fire

branches.title: Lot, and reminder of the destroyed tyrants
branches.resume: Lot and his people, then a brief reminder of Hud, Salih, Shu'ayb, Musa facing Pharaoh and Qarun.

children.t: Lot and his people, destruction of the corrupt city
Brief reminder of Hud, Salih, Shu'ayb, Musa facing Pharaoh and Qarun

branches.title: The parable of the spider's web
branches.resume: Relying on protectors other than Allah is as fragile as a spider's web — the weakest of houses.

children.t: The spider's web, the weakest of houses — parable of the false protectors

branches.title: Prayer, debating the People of the Book
branches.resume: Prayer keeps away from indecency; debating the People of the Book in the best manner.

children.t: Prayer keeps away from indecency; debating in the best manner
Those who received the Book recognize this revelation

branches.title: Steadfastness, Allah's vast earth
branches.resume: Steadfastness asked of the persecuted, invitation to emigrate on Allah's vast earth.

children.t: Steadfastness in the face of persecution, Allah's earth is vast

branches.title: Trust in sustenance
branches.resume: How many creatures do not provide for their own sustenance; those who strive will be guided.

children.t: Trust in Allah's provision, guidance promised to whoever strives sincerely
